host.description: Network interface to bind to for client connections.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for client connections (standard QMF port is 5672).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

client_ca_file.description: Path to a CA bundle file for verifying client certificates (mutual TLS). Leave blank to disable client cert verification.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to server TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required to enable TLS.

tls_key_file.description: Path to server TLS private key file (PEM format, unencrypted). Required to enable TLS.

force_tls.description: If true, reject non-TLS connections. Only effective if TLS is enabled.

thread_count.description: Number of worker threads for message processing (recommended: 2–8, depending on CPU cores).

max_queue_depth.description: Maximum pending messages per worker before backpressure kicks in.

process_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (ms) a worker may spend processing a message before it’s retried or moved to a dead-letter queue.

backend.description: Storage backend for messages and metadata.

file_path.description: File path for the local message database (used only with `file` backend).

redis_url.description: Redis connection URL (e.g., `redis://user:pass@host:6379/0`) for Redis backend.

redis_password.description: Redis authentication password (optional). If omitted and Redis requires auth, connection will fail.

max_messages_per_queue.description: Maximum number of messages retained per queue (0 means unlimited).

durable.description: If true, ensure writes are synced to disk (file) or replicated (Redis). Reduces throughput for increased reliability.

path.description: Path to the log file. Use `-` to log to stdout.

json_output.description: If true, emit structured JSON log lines instead of human-readable text.

default_ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for messages in a queue if not explicitly overridden.

default_max_size_bytes.description: Maximum total size (bytes) a queue may grow to, per queue.

per_queues.description: List of named queues with custom configuration overrides. Each entry defines a queue name and optional per-queue TTL/size limits.

ttl_seconds.description: Message TTL (seconds) for this queue. If omitted, defaults to `queues.default_ttl_seconds`.

max_size_bytes.description: Max queue size (bytes) for this queue. If omitted, defaults to `queues.default_max_size_bytes`.

http_port.description: Port for the HTTP health-check endpoint (`/healthz`).

liveness_check_interval_seconds.description: Interval (seconds) between internal liveness checks (e.g., connection pool health).
